requestedAction: Close issues already fixed, accepted and merged to main.

currentMainRegressions.scope: 24 targeted Node suites on an isolated export of exact current-main sources, all passed. This is not a fresh full-workbench or Windows-device acceptance.

verification.existingBrowserEvidence: Individual cycle107-130 records contain actual Chromium component/worker/WebGL, pixels, normal controls and lifecycle acceptance. Read from current main; not rerun as full product UI.
verification.currentMainCIBoundary: Current main overall quick/gate were failing at inspection; do not claim current whole-main CI success. Existing PR609 complete CI and current passing issue-related suites establish this closure scope. No unrelated CI repair performed.
verification.readback: Every one of the 60 issues was independently re-read from the live closed-issues collection; all state=closed and state_reason=completed. All 50 retained issues were independently re-read as open.
harnessCorrections: System Python lacks tarfile.extractall(filter=...); validated member names/types before extraction. Initial scripts did not exist and were recorded as harness failures.
OBJ suite initially lacked cube.obj in the minimal export; copied the exact-main fixture and reran successfully without product changes.
